description:
Outcome: Model households, seasons, plots and history; source: brief.md Background and Rules.
Scope: Model 40 plot IDs, household identity, occupancy dates, distinct application windows, applications and prior allocations; seed/import previous season and prepare coordinator setup/reconciliation operations, authenticated in A1/A2.
Excludes: online payments and tool lending; plot map excluded from first version and retained only in T-018.
Acceptance: One active holding per household and one active holder per plot per season; ended holdings retained; duplicate household reconciliation preserves earliest valid application and requires explicit conflict resolution for competing holdings; invalid dates rejected.
Behaviour: Invalid import rows reported without partial corruption; no silent history loss; retries supported.
Verification: Fixtures for duplicates, absent prior history, 40 plots, date validation, release/reassignment, conflicting holdings and season rollover.
Prerequisites: T-001, T-003.
Assumptions: Approved setup assumptions: one household account; coordinator configures local timezone/application window; default occupancy March 1-October 31; returning means immediately prior season; initial final allocation after February 1 cutoff, advisory preferences and application order within groups; FIFO waiting list; no same-season reapplication after withdrawal/release; active holdings unique, history preserved; own active-plot reporting with coordinator-only report access; daily digest defaults to 08:00 local and skips empty days. No existing implementation. T-003 reviews provisional domain rules.
title: Model households, seasons, plots and history
